scripts.script:
-- Gui to Lua
-- Version: 3.2
-- Instances:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local TextButton = Instance.new("TextButton")

-- Properties:
ScreenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 255, 121)
Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.113886848, 0, 0.225967541, 0)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 177, 0, 162)
Frame.Active = true -- Required for dragging to work smoothly

TextLabel.Parent = Frame
TextLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 255)
TextLabel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
TextLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 177, 0, 50)
TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
TextLabel.Text = "FLY SCRIPT"
TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
TextLabel.TextSize = 14.000

TextButton.Parent = Frame
TextButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(151, 255, 128)
TextButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
TextButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
TextButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.30864197, 0)
TextButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 177, 0, 112)
TextButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
TextButton.Text = "FLY"
TextButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
TextButton.TextSize = 14.000

-- ==========================================
-- DRAGGABLE GUI LOGIC
-- ==========================================
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local dragging
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPos

local function update(input)
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	Frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Frame.Position
		
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		update(input)
	end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- FLY SCRIPT LOGIC
-- ==========================================
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local isFlying = false
local flySpeed = 50

local function toggleFly()
	isFlying = not isFlying
	TextButton.Text = isFlying and "UNFLY" or "FLY"
	
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	
	if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid then return end
	
	if isFlying then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		
		-- Fly Loop
		task.spawn(function()
			-- Create forces to hold character in air smoothly
			local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
			bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(10000, 10000, 10000)
			bv.Parent = humanoidRootPart
			
			local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
			bg.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
			bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(10000, 10000, 10000)
			bg.Parent = humanoidRootPart
			
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			
			while isFlying and character.Parent and humanoidRootPart.Parent do
				local moveDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
				
				-- Align flight directions with where your camera is looking
				local cameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
				local lookVector = cameraCFrame.LookVector
				local rightVector = cameraCFrame.RightVector
				
				local direction = (lookVector * -moveDirection.Z) + (rightVector * moveDirection.X)
				if moveDirection.Y ~= 0 then
					direction = direction + Vector3.new(0, moveDirection.Y, 0)
				end
				
				if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
					bv.Velocity = direction.Unit * flySpeed
				else
					bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				
				bg.CFrame = cameraCFrame
				task.wait()
			end
			
			-- Clean up objects when flying is turned off
			bv:Destroy()
			bg:Destroy()
		end)
	else
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
end

TextButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

scripts.script:
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 💣 TimeBomb - Holding & Auto Assist (VEX TOP ONE)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- الحالة
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local State = {
    AutoAssistEnabled = false,
    HoldingEnabled = false,
    AssistConn = nil,
    HoldingConn = nil
}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- أدوات مساعدة
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function new(class, props, parent)
    local inst = Instance.new(class)
    if props then
        for k, v in pairs(props) do
            pcall(function() inst[k] = v end)
        end
    end
    if parent then inst.Parent = parent end
    return inst
end

local function corner(p, r)
    return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0, 10) }, p)
end

local function getHRP(player)
    local c = player.Character
    if not c then return nil end
    return c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getHum(player)
    local c = player.Character
    if not c then return nil end
    return c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function getPlayerInFront()
    local myHRP = getHRP(LocalPlayer)
    if not myHRP then return nil end
    local closest, closestDist = nil, 25 
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local pHRP = getHRP(p)
            local pHum = getHum(p)
            if pHRP and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (pHRP.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < closestDist then
                    local directionToPlayer = (pHRP.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
                    local cameraLook = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                    if directionToPlayer:Dot(cameraLook) > 0 then
                        closestDist = dist
                        closest = p
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function getClosestPlayer()
    local myHRP = getHRP(LocalPlayer)
    if not myHRP then return nil, math.huge end
    local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local pHRP = getHRP(p)
            local pHum = getHum(p)
            if pHRP and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 then
                local dist = (pHRP.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < closestDist then
                    closestDist = dist
                    closest = p
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest, closestDist
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 1. HOLDING
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function startHolding()
    if State.HoldingConn then return end
    local myHum = getHum(LocalPlayer)
    if myHum then myHum.AutoRotate = false end
    
    State.HoldingConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not State.HoldingEnabled then return end
        local target = getPlayerInFront()
        if not target then return end

        local myHRP = getHRP(LocalPlayer)
        local tHRP = getHRP(target)

        if myHRP and tHRP then
            pcall(function()
                local lookDirection = (tHRP.Position - myHRP.Position).Unit
                local reversedDirection = -lookDirection
                myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHRP.Position, myHRP.Position + reversedDirection)
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopHolding()
    local myHum = getHum(LocalPlayer)
    if myHum then myHum.AutoRotate = true end
    if State.HoldingConn then
        State.HoldingConn:Disconnect()
        State.HoldingConn = nil
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 2. AUTO ASSIST
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function hasTool()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return false end
    return char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") ~= nil
end

local function startAutoAssist()
    if State.AssistConn then return end
    
    State.AssistConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not State.AutoAssistEnabled then return end
        if not hasTool() then return end

        local target, dist = getClosestPlayer()
        local myHum = getHum(LocalPlayer)
        local tHRP = getHRP(target)

        if target and myHum and tHRP then
            if dist > 4 then
                myHum:MoveTo(tHRP.Position)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopAutoAssist()
    if State.AssistConn then
        State.AssistConn:Disconnect()
        State.AssistConn = nil
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- واجهة المستخدم
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TimeBombButtons")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "TimeBombButtons",
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, PlayerGui)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- اسم السكربت (VEX TOP ONE)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local titleLabel = new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 60),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 20),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "VEX TOP ONE",
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
    TextSize = 38,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextStrokeTransparency = 0, 
    TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
}, gui)

local gradient = new("UIGradient", {
    Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(180, 90, 220)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 240))
    }),
    Rotation = 90,
}, titleLabel)

local shadow = titleLabel:Clone()
shadow.Parent = gui
shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 23)
shadow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
shadow.TextTransparency = 0.5
shadow.ZIndex = titleLabel.ZIndex - 1
shadow.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
if shadow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then
    shadow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient"):Destroy()
end

task.spawn(function()
    while gui.Parent do
        task.wait(0.5)
        titleLabel:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 60), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.5, true)
        task.wait(0.5)
        titleLabel:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 60), Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.5, true)
    end
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- الأزرار
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function createButton(text, pos, callback)
    local frame = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 50),
        Position = pos,
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, gui)
    corner(frame, UDim.new(0, 10))
    new("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Thickness = 2 }, frame)

    local btn = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 16,
    }, frame)

    local lockBtn = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 25),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 5),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40),
        Text = "🔒",
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 14,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, frame)
    corner(lockBtn, UDim.new(1, 0))

    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    local isUnlocked = false

    lockBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if isUnlocked then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = frame.Position
            end
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)

    lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        isUnlocked = not isUnlocked
        if isUnlocked then
            lockBtn.Text = "🔓"
        else
            lockBtn.Text = "🔒"
        end
    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        callback(btn, frame)
    end)

    return btn, frame
end

local holdBtn, holdFrame = createButton("HOLDING", UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -60), function(btn, frame)
    State.HoldingEnabled = not State.HoldingEnabled
    if State.HoldingEnabled then
        btn.Text = "HOLDING: ON"
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50)
        startHolding()
    else
        btn.Text = "HOLDING"
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
        stopHolding()
    end
end)

local assistBtn, assistFrame = createButton("AUTO ASSIST", UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, 0), function(btn, frame)
    State.AutoAssistEnabled = not State.AutoAssistEnabled
    if State.AutoAssistEnabled then
        btn.Text = "AUTO: ON"
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50)
        startAutoAssist()
    else
        btn.Text = "AUTO ASSIST"
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
        stopAutoAssist()
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        State.HoldingEnabled = not State.HoldingEnabled
        if State.HoldingEnabled then
            holdBtn.Text = "HOLDING: ON"
            holdFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50)
            startHolding()
        else
            holdBtn.Text = "HOLDING"
            holdFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
            stopHolding()
        end
    end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        State.AutoAssistEnabled = not State.AutoAssistEnabled
        if State.AutoAssistEnabled then
            assistBtn.Text = "AUTO: ON"
            assistFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 205, 50)
            startAutoAssist()
        else
            assistBtn.Text = "AUTO ASSIST"
            assistFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
            stopAutoAssist()
        end
    end
end)

print("[VEX TOP ONE] تم التحميل بنجاح")

local function executeTopAdminCommand(cmdText)
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local success, requestCommand = pcall(function()
        return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient").Signals.RequestCommandSilent
    end)
    if success and requestCommand then
        pcall(function()
            requestCommand:InvokeServer(cmdText)
        end)
    end
end

ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local code = ScriptBox.Text
    
    if string.match(code, "https?://") and not string.match(code, "\n") then
        local success, res = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(code)
        end)
        if success and res then
            code = res
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Info]: Successfully fetched script from URL!"
        else
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Error]: Failed to fetch URL content!"
            return
        end
    end

    local func, syntaxErr = loadstring(code)
    if func then
        local success, err = pcall(func)
        if success then
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Success]: Script executed successfully without errors."
        else
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Runtime Error]: " .. tostring(err)
        end
    else
        ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
        ConsoleBox.Text = "[Syntax Error]: " .. tostring(syntaxErr)
    end
end)

ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScriptBox.Text = ""

end)

    else
        ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
        ConsoleBox.Text = "[Warning]: setclipboard is not supported on this executor."
    end
end)

local function findSyncAPI()
    for _, obj in ipairs(LocalPlayer:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "SyncAPI" then return obj end
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "SyncAPI" then return obj end
    end
    return nil
end

SkyboxBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local textureId = SkyboxInput.Text
    local sync = findSyncAPI()
    if not sync then return end
    local endpoint = sync.ServerEndpoint
    if textureId == "" then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local spawnCF = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
    endpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", spawnCF, workspace)
    task.wait(0.2)
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Position - spawnCF.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SetName", {part}, "Sky")
            endpoint:InvokeServer("CreateMeshes", {{["Part"] = part}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["MeshId"] = "rbxassetid://111891702759441"}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["TextureId"] = "rbxassetid://" .. textureId}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["Scale"] = Vector3.new(1000, 1000, 1000)}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, true)
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncAnchor", {{["Part"] = part, ["Anchored"] = true}})
            break
        end
    end
end)

local function getTargetPlayerName()
    local text = TargetInput.Text
    if text == "" or string.lower(text) == "all" then return "all" end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.sub(string.lower(p.Name), 1, string.len(text)) == string.lower(text) then
            return p.Name
        end
    end
    return text
end

local function executeHDCommand(cmdFormat, extraArg)
    local target = getTargetPlayerName()
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local success, requestCommand = pcall(function()
        return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient").Signals.RequestCommandSilent
    end)
    if success and requestCommand then
        pcall(function()
            local fullCmd = extraArg and string.format(cmdFormat, target, extraArg) or string.format(cmdFormat, target)
            requestCommand:InvokeServer(fullCmd)
        end)
    end
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local ROOT = "BABFT_Schematics"
local CHECK_INTERVAL = 0.3
local POSITION_TOLERANCE = 0.35
local ROTATION_TOLERANCE = math.rad(2)
local Schematics = {}
local Holograms = {}
local HologramOffset = Vector3.zero
local MoveHandles = nil
local MoveAnchor = nil
local MoveEnabled = false
local Checking = false
local LastCheck = 0
local function getFolder(playerName)
playerName = playerName or Player.Name
local blocksRoot = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
if not blocksRoot then return nil end
return blocksRoot:FindFirstChild(playerName)
end
local function getPPart(model)
if model:IsA("BasePart") then
return model
end
local part = model:FindFirstChild("PPart", true)
if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
return part
end
return nil
end
local function getBlocks(playerName)
local result = {}
local folder = getFolder(playerName)
if not folder then return result end
for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
local part = getPPart(model)
if part then
table.insert(result, {
model = model,
part = part
})
end
end
return result
end
-- FILE SYSTEM
local function fileSystemAvailable()
return type(writefile) == "function"
and type(readfile) == "function"
and type(listfiles) == "function"
end
local function ensureDirectory()
if type(isfolder) == "function"
and type(makefolder) == "function" then
if not isfolder(ROOT) then
makefolder(ROOT)
end
return isfolder(ROOT)
end
return false
end
local function safeFileName(name)
name = name:gsub("[^%w_ %-]", "")
name = name:gsub("^%s+", "")
name = name:gsub("%s+$", "")
return name
end
local function filePath(name)
return ROOT .. "/" .. name .. ".json"
end
local function getRotation(cf)
local x, y, z = cf:ToOrientation()
return {x, y, z}
end
local function encodeProperty(value)
local kind = typeof(value)
if kind == "nil" or kind == "boolean" or kind == "number" or kind == "string" then
return {kind = kind, value = value}
elseif kind == "Vector3" then
return {kind = kind, value = {value.X, value.Y, value.Z}}
elseif kind == "Vector2" then
return {kind = kind, value = {value.X, value.Y}}
elseif kind == "Color3" then
return {kind = kind, value = {value.R, value.G, value.B}}
elseif kind == "CFrame" then
return {kind = kind, value = {value:GetComponents()}}
elseif kind == "BrickColor" then
return {kind = kind, value = value.Number}
elseif kind == "EnumItem" then
return {
kind = kind,
enumType = value.EnumType.Name,
value = value.Name
}
elseif kind == "NumberRange" then
return {kind = kind, value = {value.Min, value.Max}}
elseif kind == "UDim" then
return {kind = kind, value = {value.Scale, value.Offset}}
elseif kind == "UDim2" then
return {
kind = kind,
value = {
value.X.Scale, value.X.Offset,
value.Y.Scale, value.Y.Offset
}
}
elseif kind == "Rect" then
return {
kind = kind,
value = {
value.Min.X, value.Min.Y,
value.Max.X, value.Max.Y
}
}
elseif kind == "PhysicalProperties" then
return {
kind = kind,
value = {
value.Density, value.Friction, value.Elasticity,
value.FrictionWeight, value.ElasticityWeight
}
}
end
-- Instance references, Content values and unsupported types are skipped.
return nil
end
local function decodeProperty(data)
if type(data) ~= "table" then
return nil, false
end
local v = data.value
local kind = data.kind
if kind == "nil" then
return nil, true
elseif kind == "boolean" or kind == "number" or kind == "string" then
return v, true
elseif kind == "Vector3" then
return Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3]), true
elseif kind == "Vector2" then
return Vector2.new(v[1], v[2]), true
elseif kind == "Color3" then
return Color3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3]), true
elseif kind == "CFrame" then
return CFrame.new(unpack(v)), true
elseif kind == "BrickColor" then
return BrickColor.new(v), true
elseif kind == "EnumItem" then
local enumType = Enum[data.enumType]
if enumType then
return enumType[v], true
end
elseif kind == "NumberRange" then
return NumberRange.new(v[1], v[2]), true
elseif kind == "UDim" then
return UDim.new(v[1], v[2]), true
elseif kind == "UDim2" then
return UDim2.new(v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4]), true
elseif kind == "Rect" then
return Rect.new(v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4]), true
elseif kind == "PhysicalProperties" then
return PhysicalProperties.new(v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4], v[5]), true
end
return nil, false
end
-- Team anchors. The local schematic coordinates are
-- stored relative to these anchors, allowing the same build to load on any team.
local TEAM_ANCHORS = {
Magenta = {370.9347229003906, -11.899993896484375, 531.893310546875, 0},
Yellow = {-477.9656677246094, -11.899991989135742, 759.8931884765625, 180},
Green = {-477.9656677246094, -11.899991989135742, 401.8931579589844, 180},
Blue = {370.8343200683594, -11.899991989135742, 173.49319458007812, 0},
Red = {370.8343200683594, -11.899991989135742, -184.706787109375, 0},
Black = {-477.9656677246094, -11.899991989135742, 43.893150329589844, 180},
White = {-169.56568908691406, -11.899991989135742, -494.5068664550781, 90},
}
local TEAM_NAME_ALIASES = {
Magenta = "Magenta", Yellow = "Yellow", Green = "Green", Blue = "Blue",
Red = "Red", Black = "Black", White = "White",
}
local function teamNameFromColor(teamColor)
local raw = tostring(teamColor or "")
raw = raw:gsub("TeamColor", ""):gsub("Color3%(%s*", "")
for name in pairs(TEAM_ANCHORS) do
if raw:lower():find(name:lower(), 1, true) then return name end
end
-- Roblox BrickColor names may include spaces (for example, "Bright blue").
local lower = raw:lower()
if lower:find("magenta", 1, true) then return "Magenta" end
if lower:find("yellow", 1, true) or lower:find("yeller", 1, true) then return "Yellow" end
if lower:find("green", 1, true) then return "Green" end
if lower:find("blue", 1, true) then return "Blue" end
if lower:find("red", 1, true) then return "Red" end
if lower:find("black", 1, true) then return "Black" end
if lower:find("white", 1, true) then return "White" end
return nil
end
local TeamsService = game:GetService("Teams")
-- Resolve the current player's team using the game's TeamLeader StringValues first.
-- TeamLeader may contain the player's username; Team/TeamColor are fallbacks.
local function resolveTeamForPlayer(targetPlayer)
if not targetPlayer then return nil end
for _, teamName in ipairs({"blue", "black", "magenta", "green", "red", "white", "yellow"}) do
local team = TeamsService:FindFirstChild(teamName)
local leader = team and team:FindFirstChild("TeamLeader")
if leader and leader:IsA("StringValue") and leader.Value == targetPlayer.Name then
return team
end
end
if targetPlayer.Team and targetPlayer.Team:IsA("Team") then
return targetPlayer.Team
end
local color = targetPlayer.TeamColor
for _, team in ipairs(TeamsService:GetChildren()) do
if team:IsA("Team") and color and team.TeamColor == color then
return team
end
end
return nil
end
local function teamAnchorCFrame(teamOrColor)
local name
if typeof(teamOrColor) == "Instance" and teamOrColor:IsA("Team") then
name = teamNameFromColor(teamOrColor.Name) or teamNameFromColor(teamOrColor.TeamColor)
else
name = teamNameFromColor(teamOrColor)
end
local a = name and TEAM_ANCHORS[name]
if not a then return nil end
return CFrame.new(a[1], a[2], a[3]) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(a[4]), 0)
end
local function currentPlayerTeam()
return resolveTeamForPlayer(Player)
end
local function pivotFromSchematic(modelData)
local savedPivot = CFrame.new(unpack(modelData.pivot))
if modelData.coordinateSpace == "team-relative" then
local team = currentPlayerTeam()
local anchor = team and teamAnchorCFrame(team) or nil
if anchor then return (anchor * savedPivot) + HologramOffset end
warn("[Schematic] Could not resolve your team through TeamLeader/Team; using saved world coordinates.")
end
-- Backwards compatibility with older JSON files that contain world positions.
return savedPivot + HologramOffset
end
local function serializePart(part, pivot)
local relative = pivot:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
local data = {
class = part.ClassName,
name = part.Name,
cf = {relative:GetComponents()},
size = {part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z},
color = {part.Color.R, part.Color.G, part.Color.B},
transparency = part.Transparency,
reflectance = part.Reflectance,
material = part.Material.Name,
anchored = part.Anchored,
canCollide = part.CanCollide,
shape = nil,
meshId = nil,
textureId = nil,
properties = {}
}
if part:IsA("Part") then
data.shape = part.Shape.Name
end
if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
data.meshId = part.MeshId
data.textureId = part.TextureID
end
-- Capture as many properties as the executor exposes.
if type(getproperties) == "function" then
local ok, properties = pcall(getproperties, part)
if ok and type(properties) == "table" then
for propertyName, value in pairs(properties) do
local encodedOk, encoded = pcall(encodeProperty, value)
if encodedOk and encoded then
data.properties[propertyName] = encoded
end
end
end
end
return data
end
local function getRelativeInstancePath(root, instance)
    local segments = {}
    local current = instance
    while current and current ~= root do
        local parent = current.Parent
        if not parent then return nil end
        local sameNameIndex = 0
        for _, sibling in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if sibling.Name == current.Name then
                sameNameIndex += 1
                if sibling == current then break end
            end
        end
        table.insert(segments, 1, {
            name = current.Name,
            class = current.ClassName,
            index = sameNameIndex
        })
        current = parent
    end
    if current ~= root then return nil end
    return segments
end

local function findByRelativeInstancePath(root, segments)
    local current = root
    for _, segment in ipairs(segments or {}) do
        local found, sameNameIndex = nil, 0
        for _, child in ipairs(current:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == segment.name then
                sameNameIndex += 1
                if sameNameIndex == (segment.index or 1) and child.ClassName == segment.class then
                    found = child
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not found then return nil end
        current = found
    end
    return current
end

-- Use BABFT public definitions to determine which properties
-- exist for each block type. This does not depend on BlockPropertiesServer.
local cachedBlockProperties
local function getBlockPropertyDefinitions(model)
    if not cachedBlockProperties then
        local ok, module = pcall(function()
            return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Scripts.BlockProperties)
        end)
        if ok and type(module) == "table" then
            cachedBlockProperties = module
        else
            return nil
        end
    end
    local ok, definitions = pcall(function()
        return cachedBlockProperties[model.Name]
    end)
    if ok and type(definitions) == "table" then return definitions end
    return nil
end

local function serializeBlockProperties(model, definitions)
    local saved = {}
    if type(definitions) ~= "table" then return saved end
    for propertyName, definition in pairs(definitions) do
        if type(definition) == "table" and type(definition.GetState) == "function" then
            local ok, state = pcall(definition.GetState, model)
            if ok then
                local encodedOk, encoded = pcall(encodeProperty, state)
                if encodedOk and encoded then
                    saved[propertyName] = encoded
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return saved
end

-- The auxiliary ValueBase save is limited to properties recognized by the module
-- for this block; it does not dump every internal model value.
local PROPERTY_VALUE_ALIASES = {
    ["Piston length"] = {"ExtendLength"},
    ["Piston speed"] = {"Speed"},
    ["Wheel speed"] = {"MaxSpeed"},
    ["Servo angle"] = {"TargetAngle"},
    ["Fuse time"] = {"FuseTime"},
    ["Flight distance"] = {"FlightDistance"},
    ["Delay time"] = {"WaitDuration"},
    ["Reverse rotation"] = {"ReverseRotation"},
    ["Crosshairs"] = {"ShowCrosshairs"},
    ["Key"] = {"SemitoneOffset"},
    ["Grow head scale"] = {"HeadScale"},
    ["Grow height scale"] = {"HeightScale"},
    ["Grow width scale"] = {"WidthScale"},
    ["Grow depth scale"] = {"DepthScale"},
    ["Shrink head scale"] = {"HeadScale"},
    ["Shrink height scale"] = {"HeightScale"},
    ["Shrink width scale"] = {"WidthScale"},
    ["Shrink depth scale"] = {"DepthScale"},
    ["Aim"] = {"Aim"},
    ["And"] = {"And"}, ["Or"] = {"Or"},
    ["Xor"] = {"Xor"}, ["Not"] = {"Not"},
    ["Additive"] = {"Additive"}, ["Legacy"] = {"Legacy"},
}

local function serializeValueObjects(model, definitions)
    local values, allowedNames = {}, {}
    if type(definitions) ~= "table" then return values end
    for propertyName, definition in pairs(definitions) do
        if type(definition) == "table" and type(definition.GetState) == "function" then
            allowedNames[propertyName] = true
            for _, alias in ipairs(PROPERTY_VALUE_ALIASES[propertyName] or {}) do
                allowedNames[alias] = true
            end
        end
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("ValueBase") and allowedNames[obj.Name] then
            local path = getRelativeInstancePath(model, obj)
            if path then
                local ok, encoded = pcall(encodeProperty, obj.Value)
                if ok and encoded then
                    table.insert(values, {
                        path = path,
                        name = obj.Name,
                        class = obj.ClassName,
                        value = encoded
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return values
end

local function restoreValueObjects(model, modelData)
    if not model or not modelData or type(modelData.values) ~= "table" then return 0, 0 end
    local restored, skipped = 0, 0
    for _, saved in ipairs(modelData.values) do
        local target = findByRelativeInstancePath(model, saved.path)
        if target and target:IsA("ValueBase") and target.ClassName == saved.class then
            local decodedOk, value, valid = pcall(function()
                local v, canDecode = decodeProperty(saved.value)
                return v, canDecode
            end)
            if decodedOk and valid then
                local setOk = pcall(function() target.Value = value end)
                if setOk then restored += 1 else skipped += 1 end
            else
                skipped += 1
            end
        else
            -- The destination block does not expose this value/property: skip it.
            skipped += 1
        end
    end
    return restored, skipped
end


-- Capture BindTool structure: B1/B2/B3 tags and Beam edges between blocks.
-- IDs are stable JSON indices, not Instance references.
local function serializeBindTags(model)
    local tags = {}
    for _, tagName in ipairs({"B1", "B2", "B3", "SeatInput"}) do
        local ok, hasTag = pcall(function() return model:HasTag(tagName) end)
        if ok and hasTag then tags[#tags + 1] = tagName end
    end
    return tags
end

local function getBindingActionMap(model)
    local result = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name:sub(1, 4) == "Bind" and child.Name ~= "BindingSB" then
            local action = child:FindFirstChild("ActionName")
            if action and action:IsA("ValueBase") and type(action.Value) == "string" then
                local keyCode
                for _, value in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                    if value:IsA("ValueBase") and
                        (value.Name == "KeyCode" or value.Name == "KeyCodeValue" or value.Name == "Key") then
                        if type(value.Value) == "number" then
                            keyCode = value.Value
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                result[action.Value] = {
                    bindName = child.Name,
                    keyCode = keyCode
                }
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

local function serializeBindConnections(models)
    local idByModel = {}
    for index, entry in ipairs(models) do
        idByModel[entry.model] = index
    end
    local connections, seen = {}, {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(models) do
        local sourceModel = entry.model
        for _, object in ipairs(sourceModel:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:IsA("Beam") and object.Attachment0 and object.Attachment1 then
                local function ownerFromAttachment(attachment)
                    local parent = attachment.Parent
                    local candidate = parent and parent.Parent
                    if candidate and candidate:IsA("Model") then return candidate end
                    return candidate and candidate:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or nil
                end
                local a = ownerFromAttachment(object.Attachment0)
                local b = ownerFromAttachment(object.Attachment1)
                local aid, bid = idByModel[a], idByModel[b]
                if aid and bid and aid ~= bid then
                    local left, right = math.min(aid, bid), math.max(aid, bid)
                    local key = tostring(left) .. ":" .. tostring(right)
                    if not seen[key] then
                        seen[key] = true
                        local actionSource, actionSourceId = a, aid
                        if not a:HasTag("B1") and b:HasTag("B1") then
                            actionSource, actionSourceId = b, bid
                        end
                        local actionNames = {}
                        for actionName in pairs(getBindingActionMap(actionSource) or {}) do
                            actionNames[#actionNames + 1] = actionName
                        end
                        table.sort(actionNames)
                        connections[#connections + 1] = {
                            a = aid,
                            b = bid,
                            actionSource = actionSourceId,
                            aTags = serializeBindTags(a),
                            bTags = serializeBindTags(b),
                            actions = actionNames
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return connections
end

local function serializeModel(model, sourceAnchor)
local worldPivot = model:GetPivot()
local pivot = sourceAnchor and sourceAnchor:ToObjectSpace(worldPivot) or worldPivot
local parts = {}
for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(parts, serializePart(obj, worldPivot))
end
end
local mainPart = getPPart(model)
local mainRelative = nil
if mainPart then
mainRelative = {
worldPivot:ToObjectSpace(mainPart.CFrame):GetComponents()
}
end
local propertyDefinitions = getBlockPropertyDefinitions(model)
return {
name = model.Name,
pivot = {pivot:GetComponents()},
mainPart = mainRelative,
parts = parts,
bindTags = serializeBindTags(model),
bindActions = getBindingActionMap(model),
-- States are read with the same GetState method used by BABFT property UI.
blockProperties = serializeBlockProperties(model, propertyDefinitions),
values = serializeValueObjects(model, propertyDefinitions)
}
end
local function saveSchematic(name, targetPlayerName)
if not fileSystemAvailable() then
warn("This executor does not provide all required file functions.")
return false
end
if not ensureDirectory() then
warn("Could not create the schematics folder.")
return false
end
name = safeFileName(name)
if name == "" then
warn("Enter a valid name.")
return false
end
targetPlayerName = targetPlayerName or Player.Name
local targetFolder = getFolder(targetPlayerName)
if not targetFolder then
warn("Could not find a block folder for:", targetPlayerName)
return false
end
local models = getBlocks(targetPlayerName)
if #models == 0 then
warn("No blocks found for:", targetPlayerName)
return false
end
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local sourcePlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(targetPlayerName)
local sourceTeam = resolveTeamForPlayer(sourcePlayer)
local sourceAnchor = sourceTeam and teamAnchorCFrame(sourceTeam) or nil
if not sourceAnchor then
warn("Could not identify the team/origin for", targetPlayerName, "; using legacy world coordinates.")
end
local data = {
version = 2,
coordinateSpace = sourceAnchor and "team-relative" or "world",

local function makeCFrame(values)
return CFrame.new(
values[1], values[2], values[3],
values[4], values[5], values[6],
values[7], values[8], values[9],
values[10], values[11], values[12]
)
end
local function updateMoveAnchor()
    if not MoveAnchor or not MoveAnchor.Parent or #Holograms == 0 then return end

    local minV, maxV
    for _, item in ipairs(Holograms) do
        for _, entry in ipairs(item.parts or {}) do
            local part = entry.part
            if part and part.Parent then
                -- Compute the world-axis-aligned bounds, including each block's
                -- actual dimensions and rotation (not just its center position).
                local half = part.Size * 0.5
                local cf = part.CFrame
                for sx = -1, 1, 2 do
                    for sy = -1, 1, 2 do
                        for sz = -1, 1, 2 do
                            local corner = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
                                half.X * sx, half.Y * sy, half.Z * sz
                            ))
                            minV = minV and Vector3.new(
                                math.min(minV.X, corner.X),
                                math.min(minV.Y, corner.Y),
                                math.min(minV.Z, corner.Z)
                            ) or corner
                            maxV = maxV and Vector3.new(
                                math.max(maxV.X, corner.X),
                                math.max(maxV.Y, corner.Y),
                                math.max(maxV.Z, corner.Z)
                            ) or corner
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if minV and maxV then
        local size = maxV - minV
        -- Handles are drawn around the Adornee's faces, so make it span
        -- the entire schematic instead of using a 1x1x1 anchor.
        MoveAnchor.Size = Vector3.new(
            math.max(size.X, 0.2),
            math.max(size.Y, 0.2),
            math.max(size.Z, 0.2)
        )
        MoveAnchor.CFrame = CFrame.new((minV + maxV) / 2)
    end
end

local function setMoveMode(enabled)
    MoveEnabled = enabled and #Holograms > 0
    if MoveAnchor then MoveAnchor:Destroy(); MoveAnchor = nil end
    if MoveEnabled then
        local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Hologram") or Workspace
        MoveAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
        MoveAnchor.Name = "SchematicMoveAnchor"
        MoveAnchor.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
        MoveAnchor.Transparency = 1
        MoveAnchor.Anchored = true
        MoveAnchor.CanCollide = false
        MoveAnchor.CanTouch = false
        MoveAnchor.CanQuery = false
        MoveAnchor.CFrame = CFrame.new()
        MoveAnchor.Parent = folder
        updateMoveAnchor()
        if MoveHandles then
            MoveHandles.Adornee = MoveAnchor
            MoveHandles.Visible = true
        end
    elseif MoveHandles then
        MoveHandles.Adornee = nil
        MoveHandles.Visible = false
    end
end

local function applyHologramMove(delta)
    if delta.Magnitude < 1e-5 then return end
    HologramOffset += delta
    for _, item in ipairs(Holograms) do
        item.pivot = item.pivot + delta
        for _, entry in ipairs(item.parts or {}) do
            if entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
                entry.part.CFrame = entry.part.CFrame + delta
            end
        end
    end
    updateMoveAnchor()
end

local function reconstructPart(data, parent, pivot)
local class = data.class
local part
if class == "MeshPart"
and type(data.meshId) == "string"
and data.meshId ~= "" then
part = Instance.new("MeshPart")
pcall(function()
part.MeshId = data.meshId
part.TextureID = data.textureId or ""
end)
else
part = Instance.new("Part")
if data.shape then
pcall(function()
part.Shape = Enum.PartType[data.shape]
end)
end
end
part.Name = data.name or "PPart"
-- Restore captured properties individually. Any unsupported/read-only
-- property is skipped without stopping the rest of the reconstruction.
local properties = data.properties
if type(properties) == "table" then
for propertyName, encoded in pairs(properties) do
-- Position/orientation are applied from the relative schematic
-- transform below; visual/ghost settings are forced afterward.
local protected = {
Parent = true,
Name = true,
CFrame = true,
Position = true,
Orientation = true,
Rotation = true,
PivotOffset = true,
AssemblyRootPart = true,
AssemblyCenterOfMass = true,
AssemblyLinearVelocity = true,
AssemblyAngularVelocity = true,
ReceiveAge = true,
NetworkOwnershipRule = true,
UniqueId = true,
SourceAssetId = true,
MeshContent = true,
TextureContent = true
}
if not protected[propertyName] then
local decodedOk, value, valid = pcall(function()
local v, canDecode = decodeProperty(encoded)
return v, canDecode
end)
if decodedOk and valid then
pcall(function()
part[propertyName] = value
end)
end
end
end
end
-- Fallback for older schematic files and properties that could not be
-- serialized by getproperties().
pcall(function()
part.Size = Vector3.new(data.size[1], data.size[2], data.size[3])
end)
pcall(function()
part.Color = Color3.new(data.color[1], data.color[2], data.color[3])
end)
pcall(function()
part.Reflectance = data.reflectance or 0
end)
pcall(function()
part.Material = Enum.Material[data.material]
end)
part.Anchored = true
part.CanCollide = false
part.CanTouch = false
-- Keep schematic ghosts out of the game's building raycasts. Selection is
-- performed in screen space below, so CanQuery can safely stay false.
part.CanQuery = false
part.CastShadow = false
-- Keep holograms semi-transparent and place each part relative to pivot.
pcall(function()
part.Transparency = math.max(data.transparency or 0, 0.5)
end)
part.CFrame = pivot * makeCFrame(data.cf)
part:SetAttribute("SchematicGhost", true)
part.Parent = parent
return part
end

local function createHologram(modelData, folder)
local ghost = Instance.new("Model")
ghost.Name = modelData.name or "SchematicGhost"
ghost:SetAttribute("SchematicGhost", true)
local pivot = pivotFromSchematic(modelData)
local parts = {}
for _, partData in ipairs(modelData.parts) do
local ok, part = pcall(function()
return reconstructPart(partData, ghost, pivot)
end)
if ok and part then
table.insert(parts, {
part = part,
data = partData
})
end
end
local mainPart = nil
if modelData.mainPart then
local expectedCF = pivot * makeCFrame(modelData.mainPart)
local bestDistance = math.huge
for _, entry in ipairs(parts) do
local distance =
(entry.part.Position - expectedCF.Position).Magnitude
if distance < bestDistance then
bestDistance = distance
mainPart = entry.part
end
end
end
if not mainPart and #parts > 0 then
mainPart = parts[1].part
end
ghost.PrimaryPart = mainPart
local errorBillboard, errorLabel = createErrorLabel(mainPart, ghost.Name)
ghost.Parent = folder
table.insert(Holograms, {
model = ghost,
pivot = pivot,
parts = parts,
data = modelData,
status = "missing",
errorBillboard = errorBillboard,
errorLabel = errorLabel,
errorMessage = "MISSING: no block found at this position"
})
return ghost

local function getSchematicInventoryReport(blocks)

end

-- Count only block types actually present in the loaded schematic.
-- If Player.Data has no matching ValueBase, do not invent a zero-stock entry
-- for that name: it is not a readable inventory item and should not be listed.
local required = {}
for _, item in ipairs(blocks or {}) do
    local modelData = item and item.data
    local name = modelData and modelData.name
    if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then
        required[name] = (required[name] or 0) + 1
    end
end

local missing = {}
for name, needed in pairs(required) do
    local value = dataFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
    if value and value:IsA("ValueBase") then
        local available = tonumber(value.Value)
        if available and available < needed then
            table.insert(missing, {
                name = name,
                needed = needed,
                available = available,
                short = needed - available
            })
        end
    end
end

table.sort(missing, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end)
return #missing == 0, missing
end

-- BLOCK COMPARISON
local function angleDifference(a, b)
return math.abs(math.atan2(
math.sin(a - b),
math.cos(a - b)
))
end
local function rotationsMatch(a, b)
local ax, ay, az = a:ToOrientation()
local bx, by, bz = b:ToOrientation()
return angleDifference(ax, bx) <= ROTATION_TOLERANCE
and angleDifference(ay, by) <= ROTATION_TOLERANCE
and angleDifference(az, bz) <= ROTATION_TOLERANCE
end
-- Spatial index to avoid comparing every hologram with every block.
-- A tolerância de posição continua sendo exatamente POSITION_TOLERANCE.
local SPATIAL_CELL_SIZE = 2
local function spatialCell(position)
return math.floor(position.X / SPATIAL_CELL_SIZE),
math.floor(position.Y / SPATIAL_CELL_SIZE),
math.floor(position.Z / SPATIAL_CELL_SIZE)
end
local function buildBlockSpatialIndex(blocks)
local index = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(blocks) do
local x, y, z = spatialCell(entry.part.Position)
local key = x .. ":" .. y .. ":" .. z
local cell = index[key]
if not cell then
cell = {}
index[key] = cell
end
table.insert(cell, entry)
end
return index
end
local function findBlockAt(position, spatialIndex)
local cx, cy, cz = spatialCell(position)
local best, bestDistance = nil, POSITION_TOLERANCE
local radius = math.ceil(POSITION_TOLERANCE / SPATIAL_CELL_SIZE) + 1
for x = cx - radius, cx + radius do
for y = cy - radius, cy + radius do
for z = cz - radius, cz + radius do
local cell = spatialIndex[x .. ":" .. y .. ":" .. z]
if cell then
for _, entry in ipairs(cell) do
local distance = (entry.part.Position - position).Magnitude
if distance <= bestDistance then
best = entry
bestDistance = distance
end
end
end
end
end
end
return best
end
local function setStatus(item, status)
item.status = status
if status == "correct" then
setErrorMessage(item, "", false)
elseif status == "missing" then
setErrorMessage(item, "MISSING: place " .. tostring(item.data.name or "este bloco"), true)
elseif status == "wrong_type" then
setErrorMessage(item, item.errorMessage ~= "" and item.errorMessage or "WRONG BLOCK TYPE", true)
elseif status == "wrong_properties" then
setErrorMessage(item, item.errorMessage ~= "" and item.errorMessage or "PROPERTY MISMATCH", true)
end
local color
if status == "correct" then
color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
elseif status == "wrong_type" then
color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 35)
elseif status == "wrong_properties" then
color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 0)
else
color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
end
for _, entry in ipairs(item.parts) do
local part = entry.part
if part and part.Parent then
part.Color = color
if status == "correct" then
part.Transparency = 1
else
part.Transparency = 0.35
end
end
end
end
local function compareBlocks(force)
-- Full comparison searches for each hologram among ALL real blocks.
-- With thousands of parts, this costs O(holograms * blocks) every 0.3 seconds.
-- If floating messages are disabled, there is no reason to run this scanner.
if not force and (not Checking or not ShowAllHologramMessages) then
return
end
local blocks = getBlocks()
local spatialIndex = buildBlockSpatialIndex(blocks)
for _, item in ipairs(Holograms) do
local expected = item.data
local pivot = item.pivot
local mainPosition = pivot.Position
if expected.mainPart then
mainPosition =
(pivot * makeCFrame(expected.mainPart)).Position
end
local found = findBlockAt(mainPosition, spatialIndex)
if not found then
item.errorMessage = "MISSING: place " .. tostring(expected.name or "este bloco")
setStatus(item, "missing")
elseif found.model.Name ~= expected.name then
item.errorMessage = "TIPO: esperado " .. tostring(expected.name)
.. " | found " .. tostring(found.model.Name)
setStatus(item, "wrong_type")
else
local actual = found.part
local messages = {}
-- Size is intentionally ignored: it should not trigger a yellow warning.
local expectedRotation = pivot
if expected.mainPart then
expectedRotation = pivot * makeCFrame(expected.mainPart)
end
if not rotationsMatch(actual.CFrame, expectedRotation) then
local ex, ey, ez = expectedRotation:ToOrientation()
local ax, ay, az = actual.CFrame:ToOrientation()
table.insert(messages, string.format(
"Rotation: expected %.0f, %.0f, %.0f° | actual %.0f, %.0f, %.0f°",
math.deg(ex), math.deg(ey), math.deg(ez),
math.deg(ax), math.deg(ay), math.deg(az)
))
end
if #messages == 0 then
item.errorMessage = ""
setStatus(item, "correct")
else
item.errorMessage = table.concat(messages, "\n")
setStatus(item, "wrong_properties")
end
end
end
end

local function capturePlacedModel(blocksFolder, before, blockName, desiredCF, claimedModels, timeout)
if not blocksFolder then return nil end
local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 2)
repeat
    local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
    for _, model in ipairs(blocksFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if not before[model] and not claimedModels[model]
            and model:IsA("Model") and model.Name == blockName then
            local part = getPPart(model)
            if part then
                local distance = (part.Position - desiredCF.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < bestDistance then
                    best, bestDistance = model, distance
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if best then
        claimedModels[best] = true
        return best
    end
    task.wait(0.03)
until os.clock() >= deadline
return nil
end

if r and g and b then
return Color3.new(

math.clamp(g, 0, 1),

end

  warn("[Schematic Build] Paint batch failed:", paintErr)
 end
end
end

local function flushScaleQueue()
if not scaleRemote or #scaleQueue == 0 then
 table.clear(scaleQueue)
 return
end
local queue = scaleQueue
scaleQueue = {}
for batchStart = 1, #queue, SCALE_BATCH_SIZE do
 local batchEnd = math.min(batchStart + SCALE_BATCH_SIZE - 1, #queue)
 local total = batchEnd - batchStart + 1
 local finished = 0
 for i = batchStart, batchEnd do
  local entry = queue[i]
  task.spawn(function()
   local okScale, scaleErr = pcall(function()
    scaleRemote:InvokeServer(entry.model, entry.size, entry.cframe)
   end)
   if not okScale then
    warn("[Schematic Build] ScalingTool failed for", entry.blockName, scaleErr)
   end
   finished += 1
  end)
 end
 while finished < total and BuildRunning do
  task.wait()
 end
end
end

local function processItem(index, item)
if not BuildRunning then return end
local modelData = item.data
local blockName = modelData.name
local template = templateCache[blockName]
if template == nil then
    template = templates:FindFirstChild(blockName) or false
    templateCache[blockName] = template
end
local countValue = countValueCache[blockName]
if countValue == nil then
    countValue = dataFolder:FindFirstChild(blockName) or false
    countValueCache[blockName] = countValue
end
if template == false then template = nil end
if countValue == false then countValue = nil end
if not template or not template:IsA("Model") then
failedCount += 1
warn("[Schematic Build] Model not found in BuildingParts:", blockName)
elseif not template.PrimaryPart then
failedCount += 1
warn("[Schematic Build] Model has no PrimaryPart:", blockName)
elseif not countValue or not countValue:IsA("ValueBase") or countValue.Value <= 0 then
failedCount += 1
warn("[Schematic Build] No available units:", blockName)
else
local desiredCF
local okCF, resultCF = pcall(function()
local pivot = pivotFromSchematic(modelData)
if modelData.mainPart then
return pivot * makeCFrame(modelData.mainPart)
end
return pivot
end)
if okCF then desiredCF = resultCF end
if not desiredCF then
failedCount += 1
warn("[Schematic Build] Invalid CFrame:", blockName)
else
local relativeCF = zone.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(desiredCF)
local anchor = true
-- Keep Create Keybinds disabled during placement. BindTool connections are
-- handled in the separate restoration pass after all blocks have been placed.
local makeBinds = false
local args = {
blockName,
countValue.Value,
target,
relativeCF,
anchor,
desiredCF,
false, -- Combine Rotation: OFF
makeBinds
}
-- Snapshot before the call. Each placement searches for a new model
-- with the expected name near the requested position; it does not use the camera or
-- a ChildAdded listener that could capture the same part across 30 calls.
local before = {}
if blocksFolder then
    for _, existing in ipairs(blocksFolder:GetChildren()) do before[existing] = true end
end
local okInvoke, result = pcall(function()
    return remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end)
local newlyPlacedModel = nil
if okInvoke and result ~= false then
    newlyPlacedModel = (typeof(result) == "Instance" and
        (result:IsA("Model") and result or result:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))) or nil
    if not newlyPlacedModel or newlyPlacedModel.Parent ~= blocksFolder then
        newlyPlacedModel = capturePlacedModel(blocksFolder, before, blockName, desiredCF, claimedModels, 2)
    elseif newlyPlacedModel then
        claimedModels[newlyPlacedModel] = true
    end
end
if okInvoke and result ~= false then
placedCount += 1
if newlyPlacedModel and newlyPlacedModel.Parent == blocksFolder then
    placedModelsByIndex[index] = newlyPlacedModel
end
local propertyModel = newlyPlacedModel
if propertyModel and propertyModel.Parent == blocksFolder then
    local restored, skipped = restoreValueObjects(propertyModel, modelData)
    if skipped > 0 then
        warn("[Schematic Properties]", blockName, "values restored:", restored, "skipped:", skipped)
    end
end
-- ScalingTool: usa o modelo retornado ou capturado por nome + posição;
-- if the part cannot be identified, the tool is not applied to a random model.
local savedSize = getSavedPrimarySize(modelData)
if scaleRemote and savedSize and blocksFolder then
local placedModel = newlyPlacedModel
if placedModel and placedModel.Parent == blocksFolder then
local placedPrimary = getPPart(placedModel)
if placedPrimary then
 table.insert(scaleQueue, {model = placedModel, size = savedSize, cframe = desiredCF, blockName = blockName})
end
end
end
-- PaintingTool usa lotes de {modelo, Color3}; aplicar a cor
-- after placement to avoid one call per individual part.
local savedColor = getSavedPrimaryColor(modelData)
local placedModel = newlyPlacedModel
if paintRemote and savedColor and blocksFolder
and placedModel and placedModel.Parent == blocksFolder then
table.insert(paintQueue, {placedModel, savedColor})
-- Painting is sent after the placement batch finishes.
elseif savedColor then
warn("[Schematic Paint] Could not identify the model to paint:", blockName)
end
else
table.insert(secondPassQueue, {
index = index,
args = args,
blockName = blockName,
modelData = modelData,
desiredCF = desiredCF,
blocksFolder = blocksFolder
})
failedCount += 1
warn("[Schematic Build] Block request failed; it will be retried at the end:", blockName, result)
end
end
end
end

-- Processa a schematic em lotes de 30 chamadas concorrentes.
for batchStart = 1, #loaded, PLACEMENTS_PER_BATCH do
    if not BuildRunning then break end
    claimedModels = {}
    local batchEnd = math.min(batchStart + PLACEMENTS_PER_BATCH - 1, #loaded)
    local pendingCalls = batchEnd - batchStart + 1
    local finishedCalls = 0
    for index = batchStart, batchEnd do
        local item = loaded[index]
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(processItem, index, item)
            if not ok then
                failedCount += 1
                warn("[Schematic Build] Error on block", index, err)
            end
            finishedCalls += 1
        end)
    end
    while finishedCalls < pendingCalls and BuildRunning do
        task.wait()
    end
    flushScaleQueue()
    flushPaintQueue()
    refreshStatus(string.format("Build %d/%d | placed: %d | failures: %d", batchEnd, #loaded, placedCount, failedCount))
    if batchEnd < #loaded then task.wait(BATCH_DELAY) end
end
-- Segunda passagem somente após terminar a primeira.
if BuildRunning and #secondPassQueue > 0 then
refreshStatus(string.format("First pass complete | retrying %d blocks...", #secondPassQueue))
task.wait(1)
local remainingFailures = 0
for retryIndex, pending in ipairs(secondPassQueue) do
if not BuildRunning then break end
local blocksFolder = pending.blocksFolder
local before = {}
if blocksFolder then
for _, existing in ipairs(blocksFolder:GetChildren()) do
before[existing] = true
end
end
local okRetry, retryResult = pcall(function()
return remote:InvokeServer(unpack(pending.args))
end)
local placedModel = (typeof(retryResult) == "Instance" and
(retryResult:IsA("Model") and retryResult or retryResult:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))) or nil
if not placedModel and blocksFolder then
for _, existing in ipairs(blocksFolder:GetChildren()) do
if not before[existing] and existing:IsA("Model") and getPPart(existing) then
placedModel = existing
break
end
end
end
if okRetry and retryResult ~= false then
placedCount += 1
if placedModel and placedModel.Parent == blocksFolder and pending.index then
    placedModelsByIndex[pending.index] = placedModel
end
if placedModel and placedModel.Parent == blocksFolder then
    local restored, skipped = restoreValueObjects(placedModel, pending.modelData)
    if skipped > 0 then
        warn("[Schematic Properties]", pending.blockName, "values restored:", restored, "skipped:", skipped)
    end
end
local savedSize = getSavedPrimarySize(pending.modelData)
if scaleRemote and savedSize and placedModel and placedModel.Parent == blocksFolder then
 table.insert(scaleQueue, {model = placedModel, size = savedSize, cframe = pending.desiredCF, blockName = pending.blockName})
end
local savedColor = getSavedPrimaryColor(pending.modelData)
if paintRemote and savedColor and placedModel and placedModel.Parent == blocksFolder then
table.insert(paintQueue, {placedModel, savedColor})
if #paintQueue >= PAINT_BATCH_SIZE then flushPaintQueue() end
end
else
remainingFailures += 1
warn("[Schematic Build] Second pass failed:", pending.blockName, retryResult)
end
refreshStatus(string.format("Second pass %d/%d | placed: %d | remaining failures: %d",
retryIndex, #secondPassQueue, placedCount, remainingFailures))
end
flushScaleQueue()
flushPaintQueue()
failedCount = remainingFailures
end
-- Restore connections after all blocks exist.
-- The official BindTool exposes RF:InvokeServer(actionMap, groupA, keyMap, connected, seatInput).
local function restoreBindConnections()
    local savedConnections = loaded[1] and loaded[1].data and loaded[1].data.bindConnections
    if type(savedConnections) ~= "table" or #savedConnections == 0 then
        warn("[Schematic BindTool] This schematic has no saved connections (or is from an older version).")
        return
    end
    local bindTool = (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("BindTool"))
        or (character and character:FindFirstChild("BindTool"))
    local bindRemote = bindTool and bindTool:FindFirstChild("RF")
    if not bindRemote or not bindRemote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        warn("[Schematic BindTool] BindTool.RF not found; connections were not restored.")
        return
    end
    local restored, skipped = 0, 0
    for _, edge in ipairs(savedConnections) do
        local modelA = placedModelsByIndex[edge.a]
        local modelB = placedModelsByIndex[edge.b]
        if modelA and modelB and modelA.Parent == blocksFolder and modelB.Parent == blocksFolder then
            local function tag(model, tagName)
                local ok, result = pcall(function() return model:HasTag(tagName) end)
                return ok and result
            end
            local groupA, groupB
            if tag(modelA, "B1") and (tag(modelB, "B2") or tag(modelB, "B3")) then
                groupA, groupB = {modelA}, {modelB}
            elseif tag(modelB, "B1") and (tag(modelA, "B2") or tag(modelA, "B3")) then
                groupA, groupB = {modelB}, {modelA}
            end
            if groupA and groupB then
                local actionMap, keyMap = {}, {}
                for _, source in ipairs(groupA) do
                    for _, child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
                        if child.Name:sub(1, 4) == "Bind" and child.Name ~= "BindingSB" then
                            local action = child:FindFirstChild("ActionName")
                            if action and action:IsA("ValueBase") and type(action.Value) == "string" then
                                actionMap[action.Value] = actionMap[action.Value] or {}
                                table.insert(actionMap[action.Value], child)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, actionName in ipairs(edge.actions or {}) do
                    local savedSourceData
                    for _, hologramItem in ipairs(loaded) do
                        if hologramItem.data and hologramItem.data.id == (edge.actionSource or edge.a) then
                            savedSourceData = hologramItem.data
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    local actions = savedSourceData and savedSourceData.bindActions
                    if actions and actions[actionName] and actions[actionName].keyCode then
                        keyMap[actionName] = actions[actionName].keyCode
                    end
                end
                local seatInput = tag(groupA[1], "SeatInput") or tag(groupB[1], "SeatInput")
                local okBind, bindErr = pcall(function()
                    bindRemote:InvokeServer(actionMap, groupB, keyMap, false, seatInput)
                end)
                if okBind then
                    restored += 1
                else
                    skipped += 1
                    warn("[Schematic BindTool] Failed to restore connection:", bindErr)
                end
            else
                skipped += 1
            end
        else
            skipped += 1
        end
    end
    print("[Schematic BindTool] Ligações solicitadas:", restored, "| ignoradas:", skipped)
end
restoreBindConnections()

-- Select holograms in screen space instead of raycasting them. This lets ghost
-- parts keep CanQuery=false, so BABFT's own BuildingTool cannot snap/place blocks
-- onto the schematic merely because the user clicked it.
local Mouse = Player:GetMouse()
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local function pointInsideSchematicScreenBounds(mouseX, mouseY)
    camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false end

    for _, item in ipairs(Holograms) do
        for _, entry in ipairs(item.parts or {}) do
            local part = entry.part
            if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local cf = part.CFrame
                local half = part.Size * 0.5
                local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
                local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
                local anyOnScreen = false

                for sx = -1, 1, 2 do
                    for sy = -1, 1, 2 do
                        for sz = -1, 1, 2 do
                            local corner = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
                                half.X * sx, half.Y * sy, half.Z * sz
                            ))
                            local screen, visible = camera:WorldToScreenPoint(corner)
                            if screen.Z > 0 then
                                anyOnScreen = true
                                minX = math.min(minX, screen.X)
                                minY = math.min(minY, screen.Y)
                                maxX = math.max(maxX, screen.X)
                                maxY = math.max(maxY, screen.Y)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                if anyOnScreen and mouseX >= minX - 3 and mouseX <= maxX + 3
                    and mouseY >= minY - 3 and mouseY <= maxY + 3 then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function imageExtension(path)
    local lower = tostring(path):lower()
    return lower:match("%.png$") or lower:match("%.jpe?g$") or lower:match("%.bmp$")
end

local function normalizePath(path)
    path = tostring(path or ""):gsub("/", "\\")
    while path:find("\\\\", 1, true) and not path:match("^\\\\") do
        path = path:gsub("\\\\", "\\")
    end
    return path
end

local function joinPath(parent, child)
    parent, child = normalizePath(parent), normalizePath(child)
    if child:match("^%a:\\") or child:match("^\\\\") then return child end
    if child:lower() == parent:lower() or child:sub(1, #parent + 1):lower() == (parent .. "\\"):lower() then
        return child
    end
    -- Some executors return paths relative to their workspace, e.g. workspace\\Images\\x.png.
    local childLower, parentLower = child:lower(), parent:lower()
    local marker = parentLower:match("workspace\\(.+)$")
    if marker and childLower:sub(1, #marker + 1) == (marker .. "\\") then
        return normalizePath(parent:match("^(.*workspace)") .. "\\" .. child)
    end
    return parent:gsub("\\+$", "") .. "\\" .. child:gsub("^\\+", "")
end

local function pathIsFolder(path)
    if type(isfolder) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(isfolder, path)
        if ok and result == true then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function parentPath(path)
    path = normalizePath(path):gsub("\\+$", "")
    local parent = path:match("^(.*)\\[^\\]+$")
    if parent == "" then return nil end
    if parent and parent:match("^%a:$") then parent = parent .. "\\" end
    return parent
end

local function samePath(a, b)
    a = normalizePath(a):gsub("\\+$", "")
    b = normalizePath(b):gsub("\\+$", "")
    return a:lower() == b:lower()
end

local function listDirectory(path)
    if type(listfiles) ~= "function" then
        return nil, "Xeno listfiles() is unavailable"
    end

    path = normalizePath(path):gsub("\\+$", "")
    local attempts, attemptSeen = {}, {}
    local function addAttempt(value)
        value = normalizePath(value)
        if value ~= "" and not attemptSeen[value:lower()] then
            attemptSeen[value:lower()] = true
            attempts[#attempts + 1] = value
        end
    end

    addAttempt(path)
    local afterWorkspace = path:match("[Ww]orkspace\\(.+)$")
    if afterWorkspace then
        addAttempt("workspace\\" .. afterWorkspace)
        addAttempt(afterWorkspace)
    end
    -- Xeno may expose the same workspace through a relative Images path.
    addAttempt("Images")
    addAttempt("workspace\\Images")

    local entries, usedPath
    for _, candidate in ipairs(attempts) do
        local ok, result = pcall(listfiles, candidate)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then
            -- Prefer the first non-empty result, but keep empty result as fallback.
            if #result > 0 then
                entries, usedPath = result, candidate
                break
            elseif entries == nil then
                entries, usedPath = result, candidate
            end
        end
    end
    if type(entries) ~= "table" then
        return nil, "Cannot open folder: " .. tostring(path)
    end

    local function workspaceRelative(value)
        value = normalizePath(value)
        local rel = value:match("^[^:]*[Ww]orkspace\\(.+)$")
        if rel then return rel end
        rel = value:match("^workspace\\(.+)$")
        if rel then return rel end
        return nil
    end

    local currentRel = workspaceRelative(path)
    local currentBase = path:match("([^\\]+)$") or path
    local normalizedEntries, seen = {}, {}

    for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        if type(entry) == "string" then
            local raw = normalizePath(entry)
            local fullPath

            if raw:match("^%a:\\") or raw:match("^\\\\") then
                fullPath = raw
            else
                -- If listfiles returns a workspace-relative path, map it back to
                -- the current absolute path only when it belongs to this directory.
                local rel = workspaceRelative(raw)
                if rel then
                    if currentRel then
                        local currentLower, relLower = currentRel:lower(), rel:lower()
                        if relLower:sub(1, #currentLower + 1) == currentLower .. "\\" then
                            fullPath = path .. "\\" .. rel:sub(#currentRel + 2)
                        end
                    elseif currentBase:lower() == "images" and rel:lower():sub(1, 7) == "images\\" then
                        fullPath = path .. "\\" .. rel:sub(8)
                    end
                end
                if not fullPath then
                    local rawLower, pathLower = raw:lower(), path:lower()
                    local pathTail = path:match("([^\\]+\\[^\\]+)$")
                    if rawLower:sub(1, #pathLower + 1) == pathLower .. "\\" then
                        fullPath = raw
                    elseif pathTail and rawLower:sub(1, #pathTail + 1) == pathTail:lower() .. "\\" then
                        fullPath = path .. "\\" .. raw:sub(#pathTail + 2)
                    elseif not raw:find("\\", 1, true) then
                        fullPath = path .. "\\" .. raw
                    end
                end
            end

            if fullPath then
                fullPath = normalizePath(fullPath)
                local parent = parentPath(fullPath)
                if parent and samePath(parent, path) and not seen[fullPath:lower()] then
                    seen[fullPath:lower()] = true
                    normalizedEntries[#normalizedEntries + 1] = fullPath
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Some executor builds do not accept absolute paths in isfolder(). Try the
    -- equivalent workspace-relative path too, so folders remain recognizable.
    local function isDirectory(entryPath)
        if pathIsFolder(entryPath) then return true end
        if type(isfolder) == "function" then
            local rel = workspaceRelative(entryPath)
            if rel then
                local candidates = {"workspace\\" .. rel, rel}
                for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                    local ok, result = pcall(isfolder, candidate)
                    if ok and result == true then return true end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Folder names usually have no extension; use this only as fallback.
        return not entryPath:match("%.[^\\]+$")
    end

    table.sort(normalizedEntries, function(a, b)
        local af, bf = isDirectory(a), isDirectory(b)
        if af ~= bf then return af end
        return a:lower() < b:lower()
    end)
    return normalizedEntries
end
